segments.title: Two gorillas built a LIVING LADDER
segments.say: Two gorillas built a living ladder to reach food up high.

segments.title: The food was out of reach
segments.say: The leaves they wanted were on branches too high to reach.

segments.title: One stood. One CLIMBED her.
segments.say: So one gorilla climbed up onto the other one's back.

segments.title: They're SISTERS
segments.say: The two are sisters, at the Ramat Gan Safari in Israel.

segments.title: Nobody taught them
segments.say: Scientists say no one taught them, and researchers caught it on camera.

segments.title: Source: Tel Aviv University
segments.say: The study comes from Tel Aviv University.
Follow for Weird Animal number 26 tomorrow.
